postRestartHooks.name: legacy-bridge-health
postRestartHooks.command: bash -lc 'for i in $(seq 1 30); do curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:3000/health | python3 -c '"'"'import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); assert d.get("status") == "connected"; print("port3000 connected")'"'"' && exit 0; sleep 1; done; exit 1'

postRestartHooks.name: v2-bridge-health
postRestartHooks.command: bash -lc 'for i in $(seq 1 30); do curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:3001/health | python3 -c '"'"'import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); assert d.get("status") == "connected" and d.get("paired") is True; print("port3001 connected+paired")'"'"' && exit 0; sleep 1; done; exit 1'

verifyHooks.name: legacy-bridge-health
verifyHooks.command: bash -lc 'for i in $(seq 1 30); do curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:3000/health | python3 -c '"'"'import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); assert d.get("status") == "connected"; print("port3000 connected")'"'"' && exit 0; sleep 1; done; exit 1'
